---
title: "News"
---

Release notes for `bgms` and for this documentation site, newest first. The
package's complete change log, including breaking changes and bug fixes, is
[NEWS.md](https://github.com/Bayesian-Graphical-Modelling-Lab/bgms/blob/main/NEWS.md)
in the package repository.

## 2026-07-30: bgms 0.2.0.0 on CRAN

This release widens the model class. [`bgm()`](reference/bgm.qmd) now fits
Gaussian graphical models with `variable_type = "continuous"`, and mixed
networks of binary, ordinal, and continuous variables from a per-variable
type vector. Fitted models gained `predict()` and `simulate()` methods. The
C++ backend was rewritten around a shared NUTS sampler running its chains in
parallel; inclusion probabilities are Rao-Blackwellized by default, and
[`extract_inclusion_bf()`](reference/extractors.qmd#extract_inclusion_bf)
reports inclusion Bayes factors that stay finite where the raw average
saturates. Priors are now built with constructor functions such as
`normal_prior()` and `beta_bernoulli_prior()`. New as well:
[`prior_sensitivity_check()`](reference/prior-sensitivity.qmd), which reports
which edge verdicts depend on the slab scale you chose.

## 2026-07-30: Documentation site launched

This site replaces the reference-only pages that used to live at this address.
It adds a [User's Guide](guide/index.qmd) that explains the modelling and prior
choices behind a fit, a [Reference](reference/index.qmd) grouped by topic
rather than by help file, and a [Manual](manual/index.qmd) that documents the
C++ internals for contributors.

Links to the old pages redirect here, so existing bookmarks and citations keep
working.
